description: CHS Ring Zero is three students from Catholic High School, Sibu (Junior). We are building A1-37 VIGIL, a crew health monitor that catches the slow health changes astronauts cannot see in themselves. Wallance: systems programming. Kayla: web and data visualisation. Nathania: hardware and sensors. Our school animal is the penguin, and emperor penguins keep a two-month vigil, as VIGIL does for a crew.
